name: Nexus 6P

images.credit: April.Kai, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.CPU: 2.0 GHz octa core (4×1.55 GHz Cortex-A53 & 4×2.0 GHz Cortex-A57) 64-bit ARMv8-A

Display.Display: 5.7 in diagonal WQHD AMOLED Cinematic Display with scratch-resistant Corning Gorilla Glass 4, (518 ppi), aspect ratio, Fingerprint and smudge-resistant oleophobic coating

Cameras.Rear camera: 12.3 MP, Sony Exmor IMX377, 1.55 μm pixel size, 2.0 aperture, IR laser-assisted autofocus, 4K (30 fps) video capture, Broad-spectrum CRI-90 dual flash, 720p slow motion at 240 fps
Cameras.Front camera: 8 MP, Sony Exmor IMX179, 1.4 μm pixel size, 2.4 aperture, HD video (30 fps)

Sound.Sound: Dual front-facing stereo speakers, 3 microphones (2 front, 1 rear) with noise cancellation, 3.5 mm audio jack

Battery.Battery: 3,450 mAh Li-Po (Non-removable), 89 min charge, 6 h 24 min use

Connectivity.Connectivity: Single USB-C 2.0, NFC, Bluetooth 4.2, LTE Cat. 6, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac 2×2 MIMO (Dual-Band, 2.4 GHz & 5.0 GHz), Nano-SIM, EDGE, UMTS, CDMA
